tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: Which of the following is correct?

solution.text:
\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\hline Species & Atomic number & Number of electrons \\
\hline \mathrm{Ca}^{2+} & 20 & 20-2=18 \\
\mathrm{Cl}^{-} & 17 & 17+1=18 \\
\mathrm{s}^{2-} & 16 & 16+2=18 \\
\hline
\end{array}
For isoelectronic species, an increase in atomic number, result in decreased size. Thus, order of radius will be
$$
\mathrm{Ca}^{2+}     < \mathrm{Cl}^{-} < \mathrm{S}^{2-}
$$
